# Trey Brunson

> Trey Brunson is a Bitcoin industry professional, focused on Bitcoin since 2016, who
> created Secret Satoshis: a Bitcoin newsletter, the Bitcoin-native AI agent Agent 21, and
> the open data and code behind them.

Trey got into Bitcoin at the University of Delaware. His career spans crypto exchanges,
Bitcoin financial products and crypto venture funds, including Blockchain.com, Grant
Thornton, Binance.US, 21Shares and Tribe Capital. He is based in New York.

This site is a single page. Its live Bitcoin price, supply and market cap come from the
public mempool.space API and are not investment data; check the Secret Satoshis sources
below for research and dated releases.

## Start here

- [Trey Brunson](https://treybrunson.com/): about Trey, his work and how to reach him.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/trey-brunson): career history and contact.

## Platforms and projects

- [Secret Satoshis Newsletter](https://secretsatoshis.com/): a yearly Bitcoin price outlook and weekly market analysis that tracks it, written for long-term investors.
- [Agent 21](https://agent21.secretsatoshis.com/): the Bitcoin-native AI agent built by Secret Satoshis, in invite-only beta.
- [Open-source code](https://github.com/SecretSatoshis): the data, notebooks, charts and models behind the analysis.

## Guides for agents

- [Secret Satoshis guide](https://secretsatoshis.com/llms.txt): the newsletter, products, public data releases and code.
- [Agent 21 guide](https://agent21.secretsatoshis.com/llms.txt): public capabilities, examples and beta access.

## Optional

- [Site source](https://github.com/SecretSatoshis/Trey-Brunson-Website): this site's code, GPL-3.0.
